question: What do the exact compact source, kernel-expanded form and explicitly initialized reinterpretation produce in one fixed software WebGL2 runtime?
progress: R71 generated and hashed the exact fully preprocessed mode-7 program, then ran four source variants at three times in Chromium 143 / ANGLE Vulkan SwiftShader. Compact undefined, expanded undefined, compact zero-seeded and expanded zero-seeded results were bit-identical in RGBA32F and RGBA8; all channels were finite. Clear color did not affect the undefined output and the initialized repeat was deterministic. This is one implementation observation, not a GLSL initialization guarantee or portability proof.
nextGate: Repeat the same source-free four-program matrix on a genuinely different WebGL implementation or hardware GPU. Do not count a second Chromium process or SwiftShader flag as an independent portability root.
